text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A semi-final victory and advancing to the 
finals! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The race was so thrilling that I forgot 
all about work and was completely 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I feel this result is solely thanks to the 
bond of trust between Umamusume and 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What kind of words will you say to her for 
the upcoming finals?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
S-Splendid! It is simple, yet packed with 
so much emotion!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "You can seize the pinnacle... I'll 
do whatever it takes for you to seize 
it..." To think you'd spend your entire 
savings as a reward...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I was truly moved by your resolve. I look 
forward to your performance in the finals!
